An UX researcher designs a new software tool at home on their personal laptop, outside office hours. However, the concept for the tool emerged during a brainstorming session at work, while they were under contract with the company. In this case, who is legally the inventor, and who is most likely to own the IP rights?
options: The company is the inventor and retains ownership
The researcher is the inventor; the company still owns the IP
The researcher is automatically both inventor and owner
The company is the inventor, while the researcher owns the IP
questions.correct_answer: The researcher is the inventor; the company still owns the IP
